## Why

<!-- The reasoning, and the failure mode it prevents. If this fixes something
that shipped, say how it got there — that is usually the more useful half. -->

## How it was verified

<!-- Required. Say what you actually ran, against what.
     "make test with a real PostgreSQL", "issued against Let's Encrypt staging",

     CA" is a better sentence than one implying otherwise. A reviewer can act on
